title: Amendment of the Constitution (Art. 368)
quote: Neither rigid nor flexible but a synthesis of both

boxes.title: Article 368 basics
items: Amend "by way of **addition, variation or repeal**"
Granville Austin: "appears complicated" but "is merely diverse"

boxes.title: Procedure
steps: Bill in **either House** (not State Legislature); minister or **private member**; ==no prior Presidential sanction==
Each House **separately**: special majority; ==**no joint sitting**==
Federal provisions: ratified by **half the States**, simple majority, no time limit
President **must assent** - no veto, no return (**24th Amendment, 1971**)
